newsitem.title: UK: Euro vegoils end holiday hit session little change.
newsitem.headline: Euro vegoils end holiday hit session little change.

text.p: European vegetable oil prices ended a holiday-affected session little changed on Thursday.
Most of Europe and Malaysia are closed for holidays and traders saw little prospect of business picking up on Friday.
"A lot of people will make a long weekend of it and not bother on Friday," said one.
Trading next week will also be hit by holidays with the U.K. closed on Monday and most of the rest of Europe shut on Thursday for Ascension Day.

A surge in Chicago futures on Wednesday on a forecast of tight soybean stocks and talk of Chinese buying had little impact in Europe where soy oil was unchanged to 0.25 guilders down and rape oil closed 0.50 guilders lower.
In light trading soy oil fetched 107.50 guilders a 100 kilos for Jun/Jul and Nov/Jan while rape oil traded at 107.50 and 107.75 guilders a 100 kilos fob ex-mill.
"There was not much volume behind the business and crushers were the main buyers," one trader.
In the palm oil sector only crude palm oil was offered with sellers unchanged to $2.50 up.
Lauric oils were also quiet with coconut oil unchanged to $2.50 down while palmkernel oil was not quoted. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8062
